```{r rl-environment}
#RL environment wrapper around the Gillespie CTMC. Each step samples a
#sojourn under the chosen action, transitions the hidden true state,
#emits a noisy observation, and updates the belief via Bayesian filtering.
#The agent never sees the true state, only observations and rewards.

rl_env_new <- function(s0, T_end) {
  b <- rep(0, K); b[s0] <- 1
  list(s = s0, b = b, t_now = 0, T_end = T_end, done = FALSE)
}

rl_env_step <- function(env, action_idx) {
  a  <- actions[action_idx]
  Qa <- Q_rate[[a]]
  s  <- env$s
  ro <- pmax(Qa[s, ], 0); ro[s] <- 0
  lam <- sum(ro)

  if (lam <= 0 || env$done) {
    dt_rem <- env$T_end - env$t_now
    rew <- if (dt_rem > 0)
      (c_rate[a, s] / r_disc) * exp(-r_disc * env$t_now) *
      (1 - exp(-r_disc * dt_rem)) else 0
    env$done <- TRUE
    return(list(env = env, obs = s, reward = rew, done = TRUE))
  }

  tau <- rexp(1, lam)
  if (env$t_now + tau > env$T_end) {
    dt_rem <- env$T_end - env$t_now
    rew <- (c_rate[a, s] / r_disc) * exp(-r_disc * env$t_now) *
           (1 - exp(-r_disc * dt_rem))
    env$t_now <- env$T_end; env$done <- TRUE
    return(list(env = env, obs = s, reward = rew, done = TRUE))
  }

  rew <- (c_rate[a, s] / r_disc) * exp(-r_disc * env$t_now) *
         (1 - exp(-r_disc * tau))
  env$t_now <- env$t_now + tau

  s_new <- sample.int(K, 1, prob = ro)
  env$s <- s_new
  z <- sample.int(K, 1, prob = O_mat[s_new, ])

  A_tau  <- expm(Qa * tau)
  b_pred <- as.numeric(env$b %*% A_tau)
  b_new  <- b_pred * O_mat[, z]
  bs <- sum(b_new)
  env$b  <- if (bs > 0) b_new / bs else rep(1 / K, K)

  list(env = env, obs = z, reward = rew, done = FALSE)
}
```

```{r belief-grid}
#Q-Learning belief discretization (paper Section 4.1).
#Uniform K-simplex grid with spacing delta = 0.1 yields C(13,3) = 286 cells.

generate_simplex_grid <- function(K, delta = 0.1) {
  n <- round(1 / delta); pts <- list()
  gen <- function(rem, depth, cur) {
    if (depth == K) {
      cur[K] <- rem
      pts[[length(pts) + 1]] <<- cur / n
      return()
    }
    for (v in 0:rem) { cur[depth] <- v; gen(rem - v, depth + 1, cur) }
  }
  gen(n, 1, numeric(K))
  do.call(rbind, pts)
}

belief_grid <- generate_simplex_grid(K, delta = 0.1)
n_grid <- nrow(belief_grid)
print(paste0("Belief grid: ", n_grid, " points on the K=4 simplex (delta=0.1)"))

nearest_grid <- function(b, grid)
  which.min(rowSums(abs(sweep(grid, 2, b))))
```

```{r qlearning-train, cache=TRUE}
#Tabular Q-learning on the discretized belief grid.
#Hyperparameters per paper Section 5.1: alpha=0.1, gamma=0.99,
#epsilon decays exponentially from 1.0 to 0.05 over 5000 episodes,
#episode horizon T = 15 s.

n_episodes_ql <- 5000
alpha_ql      <- 0.1
gamma_ql      <- 0.99
T_rl          <- 15
eps_schedule  <- exp(seq(log(1.0), log(0.05), length.out = n_episodes_ql))

Q_table <- matrix(0, nrow = n_grid, ncol = M,
                  dimnames = list(NULL, actions))
episode_returns_ql <- numeric(n_episodes_ql)

set.seed(123)
for (ep in 1:n_episodes_ql) {
  s0  <- sample.int(K, 1, prob = c(0.4, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2))
  env <- rl_env_new(s0, T_rl)
  eps <- eps_schedule[ep]
  total_ret <- 0
  g <- nearest_grid(env$b, belief_grid)

  while (!env$done) {
    a_idx <- if (runif(1) < eps) sample.int(M, 1) else which.max(Q_table[g, ])
    step  <- rl_env_step(env, a_idx)
    env   <- step$env
    r     <- step$reward
    total_ret <- total_ret + r

    if (!step$done) {
      g_next <- nearest_grid(env$b, belief_grid)
      td_target <- r + gamma_ql * max(Q_table[g_next, ])
      Q_table[g, a_idx] <- Q_table[g, a_idx] +
        alpha_ql * (td_target - Q_table[g, a_idx])
      g <- g_next
    } else {
      Q_table[g, a_idx] <- Q_table[g, a_idx] +
        alpha_ql * (r - Q_table[g, a_idx])
    }
  }
  episode_returns_ql[ep] <- total_ret
}
print(paste0("Q-Learning training complete. Mean return last 500 episodes: ",
             round(mean(tail(episode_returns_ql, 500)), 3)))

#Verify learned policy at corner beliefs (paper: should match MDP optimal)
for (s in 1:K) {
  b_corner <- rep(0, K); b_corner[s] <- 1
  g <- nearest_grid(b_corner, belief_grid)
  print(paste0("  b = ", states[s], " -> Q-Learning: ",
               actions[which.max(Q_table[g, ])],
               " (MDP: ", vi$policy[states[s]], ")"))
}
```

```{r reinforce-features}
#REINFORCE feature representation (paper Section 4.2):
#11-dim phi(b) = (4 raw beliefs, 6 pairwise products, 1 belief entropy).

n_features <- 11

belief_features <- function(b) {
  phi <- b
  for (i in 1:3) for (j in (i + 1):4) phi <- c(phi, b[i] * b[j])
  ent <- -sum(b * log(b + 1e-10))
  c(phi, ent)
}

softmax_policy <- function(theta, phi) {
  logits <- theta %*% phi
  logits <- logits - max(logits)
  as.numeric(exp(logits) / sum(exp(logits)))
}

softmax_log_grad <- function(theta, phi, a_idx) {
  probs <- softmax_policy(theta, phi)
  grad  <- matrix(0, nrow = M, ncol = n_features)
  for (a in 1:M) {
    ind <- if (a == a_idx) 1 else 0
    grad[a, ] <- (ind - probs[a]) * phi
  }
  grad
}
```

```{r reinforce-train, cache=TRUE}
#Hyperparameters per paper Section 5.1: 10000 episodes, lr = 0.001,
#running-mean baseline with decay 0.99, return-to-go variance reduction.

n_episodes_re <- 10000
lr_re         <- 0.001
T_rl_re       <- 15

set.seed(456)
theta_re <- matrix(rnorm(M * n_features, sd = 0.01),
                   nrow = M, ncol = n_features)
baseline       <- 0
baseline_decay <- 0.99
episode_returns_re <- numeric(n_episodes_re)

for (ep in 1:n_episodes_re) {
  s0  <- sample.int(K, 1, prob = c(0.4, 0.2, 0.2, 0.2))
  env <- rl_env_new(s0, T_rl_re)
  log_grads <- list(); rewards <- numeric(0); step_count <- 0

  while (!env$done) {
    phi <- belief_features(env$b)
    probs <- softmax_policy(theta_re, phi)
    a_idx <- sample.int(M, 1, prob = probs)
    step_count <- step_count + 1
    log_grads[[step_count]] <- softmax_log_grad(theta_re, phi, a_idx)
    step <- rl_env_step(env, a_idx)
    env  <- step$env
    rewards <- c(rewards, step$reward)
  }

  G <- sum(rewards)
  episode_returns_re[ep] <- G
  baseline <- baseline_decay * baseline + (1 - baseline_decay) * G

  grad_sum <- matrix(0, nrow = M, ncol = n_features)
  for (t in seq_along(log_grads)) {
    G_t <- sum(rewards[t:length(rewards)])
    grad_sum <- grad_sum + (G_t - baseline) * log_grads[[t]]
  }
  theta_re <- theta_re + lr_re * grad_sum
}
print(paste0("REINFORCE training complete. Mean return last 500 episodes: ",
             round(mean(tail(episode_returns_re, 500)), 3)))

#Verify learned policy at corner beliefs
for (s in 1:K) {
  b_corner <- rep(0, K); b_corner[s] <- 1
  phi <- belief_features(b_corner)
  probs <- softmax_policy(theta_re, phi)
  print(paste0("  b = ", states[s], " -> REINFORCE: ",
               actions[which.max(probs)],
               " (MDP: ", vi$policy[states[s]], ")"))
}
```

```{r gillespie-learned}
#Gillespie simulators for the learned policies. Same belief tracking as
#gillespie_pomdp; only the action selection rule differs.

gillespie_qlearning <- function(s0, T_end) {
  cap <- 2000
  times <- numeric(cap); st_seq <- integer(cap); act_seq <- character(cap)
  idx <- 1; t_now <- 0; s <- s0
  b <- rep(0, K); b[s0] <- 1
  g <- nearest_grid(b, belief_grid)
  current_action <- actions[which.max(Q_table[g, ])]
  times[1] <- 0; st_seq[1] <- s; act_seq[1] <- current_action

  while (t_now < T_end) {
    a  <- current_action
    Qa <- Q_rate[[a]]
    ro <- pmax(Qa[s, ], 0); ro[s] <- 0
    lam <- sum(ro); if (lam <= 0) break
    tau <- rexp(1, lam); t_now <- t_now + tau
    if (t_now > T_end) break
    s <- sample.int(K, 1, prob = ro)
    z <- sample.int(K, 1, prob = O_mat[s, ])

    A_tau  <- expm(Qa * tau)
    b_pred <- as.numeric(b %*% A_tau)
    b_new  <- b_pred * O_mat[, z]
    bs <- sum(b_new)
    b <- if (bs > 0) b_new / bs else rep(1 / K, K)

    g <- nearest_grid(b, belief_grid)
    current_action <- actions[which.max(Q_table[g, ])]

    idx <- idx + 1
    if (idx > length(times)) {
      times <- c(times, numeric(cap)); st_seq <- c(st_seq, integer(cap))
      act_seq <- c(act_seq, character(cap))
    }
    times[idx] <- t_now; st_seq[idx] <- s; act_seq[idx] <- current_action
  }

  times <- times[1:idx]; st_seq <- st_seq[1:idx]; act_seq <- act_seq[1:idx]
  disc_ret <- 0
  for (i in seq_along(times)) {
    a_i <- act_seq[i]; c_i <- c_rate[a_i, st_seq[i]]
    t_start <- times[i]
    t_end_i <- if (i < idx) times[i + 1] else T_end
    dt_seg  <- t_end_i - t_start
    if (dt_seg > 0)
      disc_ret <- disc_ret +
        (c_i / r_disc) * exp(-r_disc * t_start) * (1 - exp(-r_disc * dt_seg))
  }
  list(times = times, states = st_seq, actions = act_seq, disc_return = disc_ret)
}

gillespie_reinforce <- function(s0, T_end) {
  cap <- 2000
  times <- numeric(cap); st_seq <- integer(cap); act_seq <- character(cap)
  idx <- 1; t_now <- 0; s <- s0
  b <- rep(0, K); b[s0] <- 1
  phi <- belief_features(b)
  current_action <- actions[which.max(softmax_policy(theta_re, phi))]
  times[1] <- 0; st_seq[1] <- s; act_seq[1] <- current_action

  while (t_now < T_end) {
    a  <- current_action
    Qa <- Q_rate[[a]]
    ro <- pmax(Qa[s, ], 0); ro[s] <- 0
    lam <- sum(ro); if (lam <= 0) break
    tau <- rexp(1, lam); t_now <- t_now + tau
    if (t_now > T_end) break
    s <- sample.int(K, 1, prob = ro)
    z <- sample.int(K, 1, prob = O_mat[s, ])

    A_tau  <- expm(Qa * tau)
    b_pred <- as.numeric(b %*% A_tau)
    b_new  <- b_pred * O_mat[, z]
    bs <- sum(b_new)
    b <- if (bs > 0) b_new / bs else rep(1 / K, K)

    phi <- belief_features(b)
    current_action <- actions[which.max(softmax_policy(theta_re, phi))]

    idx <- idx + 1
    if (idx > length(times)) {
      times <- c(times, numeric(cap)); st_seq <- c(st_seq, integer(cap))
      act_seq <- c(act_seq, character(cap))
    }
    times[idx] <- t_now; st_seq[idx] <- s; act_seq[idx] <- current_action
  }

  times <- times[1:idx]; st_seq <- st_seq[1:idx]; act_seq <- act_seq[1:idx]
  disc_ret <- 0
  for (i in seq_along(times)) {
    a_i <- act_seq[i]; c_i <- c_rate[a_i, st_seq[i]]
    t_start <- times[i]
    t_end_i <- if (i < idx) times[i + 1] else T_end
    dt_seg  <- t_end_i - t_start
    if (dt_seg > 0)
      disc_ret <- disc_ret +
        (c_i / r_disc) * exp(-r_disc * t_start) * (1 - exp(-r_disc * dt_seg))
  }
  list(times = times, states = st_seq, actions = act_seq, disc_return = disc_ret)
}
```

```{r six-policy-mc, cache=TRUE}
#Six-policy Monte Carlo evaluation (paper Section 5.9: N=2000 trajectories).
set.seed(2026)
N_comp <- 2000; T_comp <- 20

returns_mat <- matrix(NA, N_comp, 6)
colnames(returns_mat) <- c("Optimal MDP", "POMDP (PBVI)", "Q-Learning",
                           "REINFORCE", "MCDA (TOPSIS)", "No Intervention")

for (n in 1:N_comp) {
  tr <- gillespie_mdp(Q_rate, vi$policy, c_rate, 1, T_comp, r_disc)
  returns_mat[n, "Optimal MDP"] <- tr$disc_return

  tr <- gillespie_pomdp(Q_rate, A, pomdp$Gamma, pomdp$actions,
                        O_mat, c_rate, 1, T_comp, r_disc)
  returns_mat[n, "POMDP (PBVI)"] <- tr$disc_return

  tr <- gillespie_qlearning(1, T_comp)
  returns_mat[n, "Q-Learning"] <- tr$disc_return

  tr <- gillespie_reinforce(1, T_comp)
  returns_mat[n, "REINFORCE"] <- tr$disc_return

  tr <- gillespie_mcda(Q_rate, mcda_ideal_action, O_mat, mcda_dwell_time,
                       c_rate, 1, T_comp, r_disc)
  returns_mat[n, "MCDA (TOPSIS)"] <- tr$disc_return

  tr <- gillespie_mdp(Q_rate, policy_none, c_rate, 1, T_comp, r_disc)
  returns_mat[n, "No Intervention"] <- tr$disc_return
}

means <- colMeans(returns_mat)
print(round(means, 2))
```

```{r significance-table}
#Pairwise one-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum tests + Cliff's delta on adjacent
#policies in the descending hierarchy (paper Section 5.9, Table 3).

#Cliff's delta computed exactly via the Mann-Whitney U statistic to avoid
#the O(mn) outer-product memory cost.
cliffs_delta <- function(x, y) {
  m <- length(x); n <- length(y)
  combined <- c(x, y)
  ranks <- rank(combined)
  rx <- sum(ranks[1:m])
  U  <- rx - m * (m + 1) / 2
  2 * U / (m * n) - 1
}

cliffs_label <- function(d) {
  ad <- abs(d)
  if (ad < 0.147) "Negligible"
  else if (ad < 0.33) "Small"
  else if (ad < 0.474) "Medium"
  else "Large"
}

#Order policies by mean return (descending)
ord <- names(sort(means, decreasing = TRUE))
print(paste0("Hierarchy by mean return: ", paste(ord, collapse = " > ")))

sig_df <- data.frame(Comparison = character(0),
                     p_value = character(0),
                     Cliffs_delta = numeric(0),
                     Effect_Size = character(0),
                     stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

for (i in 1:(length(ord) - 1)) {
  better <- ord[i]; worse <- ord[i + 1]
  x <- returns_mat[, better]; y <- returns_mat[, worse]
  pv <- wilcox.test(x, y, alternative = "greater", exact = FALSE)$p.value
  d  <- cliffs_delta(x, y)
  sig_df <- rbind(sig_df, data.frame(
    Comparison   = paste0(better, " vs ", worse),
    p_value      = if (pv < 1e-3) "< 0.001" else format(round(pv, 4), nsmall = 4),
    Cliffs_delta = round(d, 3),
    Effect_Size  = cliffs_label(d),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
}

kable(sig_df,
      caption = "Pairwise one-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum tests on adjacent policies (N = 2000 trajectories per policy). Cliff's delta thresholds follow Romano et al. (2006).")
```

```{r cum-reward-curves, cache=TRUE}
#Cumulative discounted reward curves for all six policies, matching the
#layout of Fig03 panel A but with the two model-free agents included.

set.seed(2027)
N_curve <- 500; t_pts <- seq(0, 20, by = 0.2)
n_pts <- length(t_pts)

cum_mats <- list(
  "Optimal MDP"     = matrix(NA, N_curve, n_pts),
  "POMDP (PBVI)"    = matrix(NA, N_curve, n_pts),
  "Q-Learning"      = matrix(NA, N_curve, n_pts),
  "REINFORCE"       = matrix(NA, N_curve, n_pts),
  "MCDA (TOPSIS)"   = matrix(NA, N_curve, n_pts),
  "No Intervention" = matrix(NA, N_curve, n_pts)
)

for (n in 1:N_curve) {
  tr <- gillespie_mdp(Q_rate, vi$policy, c_rate, 1, 20, r_disc)
  cum_mats[["Optimal MDP"]][n, ] <-
    cum_reward_at_pts(tr, t_pts, vi$policy, c_rate, r_disc)

  tr <- gillespie_pomdp(Q_rate, A, pomdp$Gamma, pomdp$actions,
                        O_mat, c_rate, 1, 20, r_disc)
  cum_mats[["POMDP (PBVI)"]][n, ] <- cum_reward_at_pts_pomdp(tr, t_pts, c_rate, r_disc)

  tr <- gillespie_qlearning(1, 20)
  cum_mats[["Q-Learning"]][n, ] <- cum_reward_at_pts_pomdp(tr, t_pts, c_rate, r_disc)

  tr <- gillespie_reinforce(1, 20)
  cum_mats[["REINFORCE"]][n, ] <- cum_reward_at_pts_pomdp(tr, t_pts, c_rate, r_disc)

  tr <- gillespie_mcda(Q_rate, mcda_ideal_action, O_mat, mcda_dwell_time,
                       c_rate, 1, 20, r_disc)
  cum_mats[["MCDA (TOPSIS)"]][n, ] <-
    cum_reward_at_pts_mcda(tr, t_pts, mcda_ideal_action, c_rate, r_disc)

  tr <- gillespie_mdp(Q_rate, policy_none, c_rate, 1, 20, r_disc)
  cum_mats[["No Intervention"]][n, ] <-
    cum_reward_at_pts(tr, t_pts, policy_none, c_rate, r_disc)
}

curve_df <- data.frame()
for (pol in names(cum_mats)) {
  mat <- cum_mats[[pol]]
  for (j in seq_along(t_pts)) {
    curve_df <- rbind(curve_df, data.frame(
      time = t_pts[j], policy = pol,
      mean = mean(mat[, j]),
      q25 = quantile(mat[, j], 0.25),
      q75 = quantile(mat[, j], 0.75)))
  }
}
curve_df$policy <- factor(curve_df$policy, levels = names(palette_policy6))
```
